summaries.challenging: Your budget covers about {coverage} of the average market cost. Nothing is impossible: here are two tips to bring the dream closer to reality.
summaries.tight: Your budget covers about {coverage} of the average market cost. A few well-chosen trade-offs will do.
summaries.comfortable: Your budget exceeds the average market cost, leaving room for the touches that make a difference.

challenging.title: Trim the guest list
challenging.body: At average market prices, your budget welcomes about {affordableGuests} guests. A larger cocktail hour followed by a more intimate dinner is an elegant compromise.

tight.title: Aim for shoulder season
tight.body: A Saturday in May or September rather than midsummer: venues and caterers are often more flexible.

experience.title: Elevate the experience
experience.body: Your margin can fund what guests remember: a next-day brunch, a two-day photographer, beautiful lighting.

reserve.title: Keep a reserve
reserve.body: Set aside about 10% for the unexpected: the secret to calm planning.

chateau.title: The château, midweek
chateau.body: Many estates offer much gentler rates from Sunday to Thursday, or outside peak season.

countryside.title: The countryside, au naturel
countryside.body: A barn or a meadow needs little dressing: wildflowers, string lights and long tables are enough to set the mood.

beach.title: The beach, simply
beach.body: A food truck or a seafood grill: the boho spirit pairs beautifully with relaxed service.

urban.title: The loft, unadorned
urban.body: An industrial venue speaks for itself: a few generous floral pieces beat decorating everywhere.

interactions.title: Encourage conversation
interactions.body: Seat guests who share a passion, a job or an age together: conversations will start on their own.

inclusion.title: Include every guest
inclusion.body: Nobody should feel left out: seat everyone next to at least one person they know.

singles.title: Celebrate the singles
singles.body: Rather than a “singles table”, spread them across lively tables where new friendships can bloom.

conflicts.title: Avoid conflicts
conflicts.body: Quietly keep apart people who don’t get along: one table between them is often enough to keep the evening serene.

children.title: A space for children
children.body: A children’s table close to their parents, with a few activities, lets everyone enjoy the meal.

generations.title: Mix the generations
generations.body: Blend ages: a storytelling great-uncle and young cousins often make the merriest table.

comfort.title: Comfort first
comfort.body: Think of older guests and those with reduced mobility: away from the speakers, close to exits and restrooms.

flexibility.title: Stay flexible
flexibility.body: Keep one or two seats free for last-minute surprises: an extra guest, a change of plus-one.

advice.default: Go for the essentials: call rather than email, and decide within the week.
advice.book_venue: Popular venues book up a year ahead: ask about weekday availability or cancellations.
advice.book_town_hall: Call the town hall today to secure the date and time of the civil ceremony.
advice.book_officiant: Contact the parish or celebrant this week: their diaries fill quickly.
advice.book_catering: Favour a caterer already listed by your venue: they know the kitchens and constraints.
advice.book_photographer: In-demand photographers are booked: widen your search to nearby regions.
advice.choose_attire: Made-to-measure takes months: look at ready-to-wear or in-stock collections.
advice.design_invitations: Pick a design and approve the wording in one evening: sending can’t wait.
advice.send_invitations: Send an online invitation now; the paper one can follow.
advice.birth_certificates: Request them online from your birthplace’s town hall: they must be under 3 months old when you file.
advice.town_hall_file: Call the town hall today: the banns must be published 10 days before the ceremony.
advice.religious_preparation: Ask the parish for an accelerated preparation.
advice.book_accommodation: Hold a block of rooms with free cancellation, then share the link with guests.
advice.explore_venues: Visit three venues at most this week, and ask for their free dates before you go.
advice.order_attire: Made-to-measure is out of reach: go for ready-to-wear and alterations.
advice.bans_publication: Call the town hall: the banns must be displayed 10 days before the ceremony.

welcome.title: A registry that feels like you
welcome.lead: A beautiful registry is more than an inventory: it tells the story of your life together, today’s and the one you imagine. Take ten minutes, ideally together. Everything stays editable.

everyday.title: Your everyday, room by room
everyday.lead: Walk around your home. What’s missing, what’s worn out, what you’ve long dreamt of replacing: from Sunday tableware to bed linen, that’s often where the gifts that brighten every day are hiding.

passions.title: What you love doing together
passions.lead: Think of your best shared moments: a dinner you cook together, an impromptu weekend, a vegetable garden that grows. Gifts that feed these moments are the ones remembered longest, objects and experiences alike.

lasting.title: Things that last through the years
lasting.lead: Some gifts are passed down. Choose quality over quantity, noble materials over passing trends: a beautiful piece chosen today will still be with you in twenty years, and perhaps your children after you.

openness.title: Room for your loved ones’ ideas
openness.lead: Your loved ones enjoy pleasing you in their own way, with something that reflects them or a memory they want to share. Tell them what matters to you, and leave them free to surprise you.

fund.title: The cash fund: give it meaning
fund.lead: A free contribution moves people more when it tells a story. Tell your guests what their gift will be for: the trip you dream of, your future home, a cause you care about. Three projects at most, so each keeps its meaning.

guide.title: Eight questions to ask
guide.lead: Keep them at hand during every visit.

location.label: Location
location.questions: How far from the ceremony? Reachable by train, easy to find at night, enough parking?

capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.questions: How many seated guests for dinner, standing for drinks? Is there an indoor fallback if it rains?

budget.label: Budget
budget.questions: What does the price include: tables, chairs, cleaning, power? What deposit, what cancellation terms?

style.label: Style
style.questions: Can you picture yourselves there? Light, grounds, photos: does the place tell your story without much decoration?

accommodation.label: Guest accommodation
accommodation.questions: How many beds on site? Hotels or cottages nearby, a shuttle for the ride home?

service.label: Quality of service
service.questions: Is the caterer imposed? One point of contact on the day? What do couples who married there say?

restrictions.label: Restrictions
restrictions.questions: When must the music stop? Candles, fireworks, confetti, set-up and departure times?

flexibility.label: Date flexibility
flexibility.questions: Is your date free? Other dates, a Friday, a Sunday, a hold while you decide?

tips.title: Four tips to host them well
tips.lead: Tailored to your date and the number of rooms to plan.

bookEarly.title: Book ahead
bookEarly.early: Block your rooms by {date}: nine months ahead, hotels near the venue still have room for everyone.
bookEarly.now: Now is the time: place holds this week, with free cancellation, before nearby hotels fill up.
bookEarly.late: Time is short: book today and widen your search to 30 minutes around the venue.
bookEarly.noDate: As soon as your date is set, block rooms: nine months ahead is ideal.
bookEarly.past: The big day has passed: all that’s left is to thank your hosts.
bookEarly.highSeason: Your wedding falls in peak wedding season: the best places go first.
bookEarly.guestsBy: Ask your guests to book before {date}: hotels often release unbooked rooms six weeks ahead.

groupRate.title: Negotiate group rates
groupRate.strong: With about {rooms} rooms, you have leverage: aim for 10 to 20% below the public rate.
groupRate.possible: About {rooms} rooms: many hotels offer a group rate from 5 rooms. Ask for it.
groupRate.small: Only a few rooms: still ask for a gesture, like free breakfast or a late check-out.
groupRate.ask: Call the hotel directly and ask for:

items.discount: a discount on the public rate, valid for all your guests;
items.release: free cancellation of unbooked rooms up to six weeks ahead;
items.code: a code or group name to share with your guests;
items.extras: breakfast the next morning, a late check-out after the party.

compare.title: Use comparison sites
compare.body: Compare the same hotel across several sites to know the fair price, then call it: booking direct, a group rate is often better.

budget.title: Explore budget alternatives
budget.body: Not every night needs a hotel:

ideas.gite: a family or group of friends shares the bill.
ideas.rental: a large house rented together, often cheaper than a room each.
ideas.guesthouse: a bed and breakfast, warm and close to the venue.
ideas.camping: a campsite or glamping for the youngest and most adventurous.
ideas.family: local friends and family happy to host a few guests.

budget.shuttle: And for those who can head home that night, a return shuttle can save a hotel stay.

catering.label: Catering
catering.title: The caterer
catering.intro: The meal is the most shared memory of the day: compare menus, tastings and what each quote really includes.
catering.when: Book 9 to 12 months ahead, right after the venue; the tasting takes place 4 to 5 months before.
catering.questions: Does the price per guest include service, tableware and linen?|How many waiters for your guests, and until when?|Is a tasting included, and for how many people?|How are special diets and children’s menus handled?|Is there a corkage fee if you bring your own wine?

florist.label: Florist
florist.title: The florist
florist.intro: Bouquet, buttonholes, centrepieces, arch: the florist gives the day its colour.
florist.when: Book 8 to 9 months ahead; the final choice of flowers is made 2 months before, by season.
florist.questions: Which flowers are in season on your date?|Are delivery, set-up and vase collection included?|Can ceremony flowers be reused at the reception?|Is a bouquet trial possible?

cake.label: Wedding cake
cake.title: The wedding cake
cake.intro: Croquembouche, tiered cake, dessert bar: taste before you choose.
cake.when: Tasting 8 months ahead, order 6 to 7 months before; confirm with the final guest count.
cake.questions: Is the price per slice or in total?|Are delivery and set-up included?|How long does it keep out of the fridge?|Does the caterer accept an outside baker?

hair.label: Hairdresser
hair.title: The hairdresser
hair.intro: A hairstyle that lasts from the ceremony to the last dance, designed with the dress and veil.
hair.when: Book 6 to 8 months ahead; the trial is 2 to 3 months before, ideally with the veil.
hair.questions: Do they travel on the morning, and at what time?|Is the trial included?|Can they also style mothers and bridesmaids?|What about a touch-up before the evening?

makeup.label: Makeup artist
makeup.title: The makeup artist
makeup.intro: Glowing makeup that looks like you and holds up to emotion and photos.
makeup.when: Book 6 to 8 months ahead, often with the hairdresser; the trial is 2 months before.
makeup.questions: Do they use long-wear products suited to your skin?|Is the trial included?|Do they stay for a touch-up before the ceremony?|Can they do your family too, at what rate?

beauty.label: Beauty treatments
beauty.title: Beauty treatments
beauty.intro: Facials, manicure, waxing, massage: a gentle programme in the weeks before.
beauty.when: Start facials 3 months ahead; manicure and waxing in the final days.
beauty.questions: What treatment plan for the last three months?|Should some treatments be avoided just before?|A group package for the wedding party?|Can you plan a relaxing moment the day before?

officiant.label: Officiant
officiant.title: The officiant
officiant.intro: Civil celebrant or religious, the officiant sets the tone and tells your story.
officiant.when: Book 10 to 12 months ahead; write the ceremony together 2 to 3 months before.
officiant.questions: How many meetings to write the ceremony?|Is a rehearsal planned?|Are travel costs included?|How do they include readings and rituals from your family?

car.label: Wedding car
car.title: The wedding car
car.intro: Vintage car, carriage or guest shuttle: the journey is part of the day.
car.when: Book 8 months ahead; confirm route and times the month before.
car.questions: Are the driver, fuel and decoration included?|How many hours of service?|What happens if it breaks down or rains?|Is a shuttle home for guests possible?

entertainment.label: Entertainment
entertainment.title: Entertainment
entertainment.intro: DJ, band, musicians for drinks: they are the ones who will get your guests dancing.
entertainment.when: Book 8 to 10 months ahead; share your playlist and key moments 1 month before.
entertainment.questions: Until what time do they play, and what does an extra hour cost?|Is sound and lighting equipment included?|Can you give them a list of songs to play and avoid?|Do they also cover the ceremony and drinks?

guest_gifts.label: Guest favours
guest_gifts.title: Guest favours
guest_gifts.intro: A keepsake for each guest, and a thank-you for those who helped.
guest_gifts.when: Order 4 to 5 months ahead, especially if personalised.
guest_gifts.questions: How long does personalisation take?|Does the price drop with quantity?|Is wrapping included?|A separate gift for the wedding party and parents?

rings.label: Wedding rings
rings.title: The wedding rings
rings.intro: You’ll wear them for a lifetime: take time to try them on together.
rings.when: Choose 4 to 6 months ahead; allow 6 to 8 weeks for engraving or a custom design.
rings.questions: How long for making and engraving?|Is resizing included later?|What warranty and care?|Does the metal match the engagement ring?

photographer.label: Photographer
photographer.title: The photographer
photographer.intro: Photos remain when everything else fades: choose an eye before a price.
photographer.when: Book 10 to 12 months ahead: good photographers are taken early.
photographer.questions: How many hours, from getting ready to the party?|How many photos, delivered how soon?|Is an engagement shoot included?|What if they can’t make it on the day?

videographer.label: Videographer
videographer.title: The videographer
videographer.intro: Voices, laughter, speeches: video keeps what photos can’t say.
videographer.when: Book 10 to 12 months ahead, often together with the photographer.
videographer.questions: How long is the film, and is there a short teaser?|Are speeches filmed in full?|Do they fly a drone, and is it allowed at the venue?|How long until delivery?

bridal_gown.label: Wedding dress
bridal_gown.title: The wedding dress
bridal_gown.intro: Fittings, alterations, accessories: the dress is chosen calmly and prepared in stages.
bridal_gown.when: Start fittings 9 to 12 months ahead; plan 2 to 3 alterations in the last 2 months.
bridal_gown.questions: How long to make this model?|Are alterations included?|Are veil and accessories offered?|Can you bring people to fittings?

bridesmaids.label: Bridesmaid dresses
bridesmaids.title: Bridesmaid dresses
bridesmaids.intro: Matching or mismatched in one palette: dresses each of them will enjoy wearing.
bridesmaids.when: Choose 6 months ahead, leaving time for orders and alterations.
bridesmaids.questions: Several sizes and cuts in one colour?|Who pays for the dresses?|Delivery time and alterations?|Can they wear them again afterwards?

groom_suit.label: Groom’s suit
groom_suit.title: The groom’s suit
groom_suit.intro: Bespoke, made to measure or off the peg: a suit that fits, designed alongside the dress.
groom_suit.when: Choose 6 to 8 months ahead for bespoke, 3 months for off the peg.
groom_suit.questions: How many fittings, and how long?|Are alterations included?|Shirt, tie or bow tie, shoes: what does it include?|Rent or buy?

groomsmen.label: Groomsmen suits
groomsmen.title: Groomsmen suits
groomsmen.intro: One shared detail is often enough: a tie, a pocket square, a buttonhole.
groomsmen.when: Organise 4 to 6 months ahead, especially for rentals.
groomsmen.questions: Group rental and a group rate?|Sizes for everyone, children included?|Who pays for the suits?|When to collect and return them?

stationery.label: Wedding stationery
stationery.title: Wedding stationery
stationery.intro: Invitations, menus, seating chart, place cards: one design from the first mailing to dinner.
stationery.when: Send invitations 3 months ahead; order on-the-day stationery 6 weeks before.
stationery.questions: Which paper and printing?|How many proofs before printing?|Delivery time and shipping costs?|Are envelopes and stamps included?

website.label: Wedding website
website.title: The wedding website
website.intro: Schedule, directions, accommodation, registry: a website gathers everything your guests look for.
website.when: Publish it with the invitations, 3 months ahead at the latest.
website.questions: Is it password protected?|Can guests reply online?|Is the domain name included?|How long does it stay online afterwards?

other.label: Other vendors
other.title: Other vendors
other.intro: Equipment rental, babysitter, food truck, photo booth: everything that fits nowhere else.
other.when: Book them 4 to 6 months ahead, depending on availability.
other.questions: What exactly does the quote include?|Delivery, set-up and collection?|Insurance for breakage?|What deposit, and what cancellation terms?
